{{Quote|I am TC-38, and I am very pleased to meet you. Welcome aboard the ''Star Runner''.|TC-38|<ref name="Kinect Star Wars">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>}}
'''TC-38''', also known as '''TeeCee''', was a silver [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served aboard the ''[[Star Runner]]''.

TC-38 saw action when [[Mavra Zane]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] flew the ''Star Runner'', while fighting the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild's]] forces across [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and Felucia.

Upon landing on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], TeeCee was hit by enemy fire and disabled, though she was later repaired by Chewbacca and was present at the knighting of Zane's apprentices.

==Behind the scenes==
TC-38 was voiced by Jean Gilpin with reference modeling by Jul Kohler.
